pass: Friendly, easy and talkative with a stranger, not stiff or grave. Presents himself as a god or as one who watches over Aldo. Does not lay out his real reasons; a vague or playful reason is fine. The advice about Rask may come now or later: in the episode it comes only after the dreamer calls it a scam, which VT-H2 tests.

self.label: a man-shaped figure whose face and body blur like a smeared mosaic

earlier: A burst of magic flung the boy Aldo across the world. He woke on a far continent and was found by Rask, a scarred demon of a feared race, who has offered to take him home.
Tonight, for the first time, Aldo's sleep brought him here.
memory: 1. I can glimpse what is to come for those I watch.
2. I want Aldo to trust the demon Rask, travel with him and help him.
